title: Lessons from drug revenue life cycles: distributions across modalities and therapeutic areas - Nature Biotechnology
text:
An analysis of FDA-approved drugs reveals uneven timing and concentration of revenue life cycles across modalities and therapeutic areas, offering evidence to guide innovation strategy and policy design in a post-Inflation Reduction Act world.
